messages:
Iris Nakamura: Quick design sync — tried the new playground schema inspector. Two things: the inspector expanding pushes down the run history and the toggle label is inconsistent. Noted while comparing runs.

Theo Alvarez: Saw that. The shift breaks quick compare flows. Could we make the inspector expand to an anchored overlay (only over the schema column) so the history stays put?

Sam Blake: Overlay preserves position but can block keyboard copy/paste flows. Another approach: keep a fixed-height inspector row that expands into an absolute-positioned panel anchored to the row (no page reflow).

Priya Desai: Copy nit: current label reads "Schema (auto-detect)" in some builds and "Inferred schema" in others. I'd prefer "Schema preview — inferred" for clarity. Also standardize action verbs: pick between "Run" and "Invoke". My vote: "Run".

Iris Nakamura: Agree on Run. Accessibility: screen reader announces "expanded" but not which function. We need aria-label like 'Schema preview for function SummarizeText (expanded)'. Also preview expand should not steal focus; only edit-expand should move focus into the editor.

A11yBot: Created ticket #734: "playground-inspector-a11y". Acceptance: verbose aria-labels, preview-expand leaves focus, edit-expand focuses first input, use polite aria-live for state changes.

Theo Alvarez: UX suggestion: the run history rows could show tiny type chips for params: small icons + 2–3 char label (TXT, NUM, FILE). Keep them non-intrusive (12–14px) and add aria-labels like 'title: text' for SR.

Sam Blake: Implementation note: chips must be semantic (role:listitem) and keyboard-focusable when user tabs into a run entry. Also ensure contrast for icon+text.

Priya Desai: For compact/dev mode, default collapse previews to keep history density. Auto-expand for first-run users by writing a flag to localStorage. We can add an account-level setting later.

Iris Nakamura: Shortcut consistency: bind 'R' to Run in playground and show tooltip "Press R to run" on the Run button. Add entry to help overlay.

A11yBot: Linked shortcut proposal #735 and added checklist for tooltip + help overlay entry.

Theo Alvarez: Small animation guidance: preview-expand should use a subtle fade+scale so it feels light; edit-expand should be a plain focus jump so SR users aren't confused by motion.

Sam Blake: Runtime caveat: collapsing results must not evict ephemeral KV cache needed for replay. I'll file a runtime ticket to confirm retention semantics.

Priya Desai: I'll push the copy fixes (label + Run verb) once Iris drops the interaction spec. Also will add microcopy for when inference fails: "Schema couldn't be inferred. Edit to continue."

Iris Nakamura: I'll draft the spec today: anchored inspector overlay, compact summary row, param chips ARIA patterns, focus rules, localStorage toggle, and shortcut mapping. Will attach a short prototype.

Theo Alvarez: Cool. Quick poll: default collapsed for power users or expanded for new users? React with :one: collapse, :two: expanded.

Sam Blake: :one:

Priya Desai: :two: (leaning new-user friendliness)

A11yBot: Poll recorded: 1 vote collapse, 1 vote expanded. Recommendation: default collapsed with first-run override.

Iris Nakamura: Perfect. TODO list in thread: [Iris] spec + prototype, [Priya] copy PR, [Sam] runtime KV ticket, [Theo] animation tokens + chip icons, [A11yBot] a11y ticket. Thanks all :thumbsup:
